value.title: Ciel in Wonderland Part I
value.synopsis: Strange things are afoot at Phantomhive manor after Sebastian sprouts rabbit ears and vanishes into a hole in the ground. When Ciel decides to follow the butler, he finds himself in a strange and familiar Wonderland.

value.title: Book of Murder: Part 1
value.synopsis: Earl Phantomhive, on behalf of the Queen, hosts a lavish reception at his castle. Unfortunately, the guest of honour is murdered the following night. The main suspect is the host himself.

value.title: Book of Murder: Part 2
value.synopsis: Thanks to Sebastian’s initiative, a remarkably talented detective-like pastor soon appears at the castle shortly after the three murders, and he throws himself into solving the crimes with great zeal.
